sections.title: Friendly error screen for page crashes

why: Likely reason: Next.js needs an error boundary file to catch failures across pages. The header also mentions error logging.

risks: The header claims the file is HIPAA-ready and Sentry integrated. Neither claim can be checked from the imports shown. A logger that sends error text to an outside service could expose health details if the message contains them.
debug: If the error screen does not show, check that the file is at the app root and that the logger import resolves. If errors are not reported, check the logger file and its configuration.
